description: Get how much of the user's Iron virtual-account spending limit is left, per direction (deposit = money in, withdrawal = money out), on a rolling 52-week window. Also reports whether Iron is currently requesting enhanced due diligence (EDD). Crossing a limit does NOT reject the transfer: Iron PAUSES it and gives the user 24 hours to supply a Source-of-Wealth document, so check this BEFORE proposing a large deposit or withdrawal. `rfiRequired: true` means Iron has an open information request waiting on the user's answers (see get_information_requests). `missingRequirements` (only while `eddRequired`) lists the Iron requirement codes still outstanding, e.g. `kyc_questionnaire`, `kyc_proof_of_residence`: the user finishes them in the Moneda app at Settings > Features and limits. `threshold: null` means the customer has no enforced cap. Thresholds are personalised per customer — never assume a number, always read it here.
name: get_virtual_account_limits
